## 0. Setup

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../scripts/00_setup.R")

pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,
  sf,
  janitor,
  nhdplusTools,
  rnaturalearth,
  ggplot2,
  ggthemes,
  viridis,
  ggrepel,
  knitr
)

dir_project <- "/Users/regi350/offline_work/GitHub/RC/metabolism_allometry"
dir_processed <- file.path(dir_project, "data/processed")
dir_merit <- file.path(dir_processed, "merit_data")
dir_figs <- file.path(dir_project, "figures")

dir.create(dir_figs, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

path_allometry_results <- file.path(dir_processed, "005_huc08_allometry_results.csv")
path_riv <- file.path(dir_merit, "002_riv_pfaf_7_MERIT_Hydro_v07_Basins_v01_CONUS_filtered.shp")

path_huc08_l1_lookup <- file.path(
  dir_project,
  "data/processed/010_huc08_l1_ecoregion_lookup.csv"
)

r2_threshold <- 0.8
slope_linear_low <- 0.8
slope_linear_high <- 1.2
```

## 1. Read allometry results and spatial layers

```{r}
allometry_results <- read_csv(path_allometry_results, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    huc = as.character(huc),
    metabolism_metric = factor(metabolism_metric, levels = c("ER", "GPP")),
    month = as.integer(month),
    month_name = factor(month.abb[month], levels = month.abb)
  )

merit_riv_v2 <- read_sf(path_riv) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    comid = as.character(comid),
    huc = as.character(huc)
  )
```

```{r}
conus <- rnaturalearth::ne_states(
  country = "United States of America",
  returnclass = "sf"
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(!postal %in% c("AK", "HI", "PR")) %>%
  st_transform(common_crs) %>%
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop")

huc08_conus <- nhdplusTools::get_huc(
  AOI = conus,
  type = "huc08"
) %>%
  clean_names()

huc_col <- names(huc08_conus)[names(huc08_conus) %in% c("huc8", "huc_8", "huc08")][1]

huc08_conus <- huc08_conus %>%
  rename(huc = all_of(huc_col)) %>%
  mutate(huc = as.character(huc)) %>%
  st_transform(common_crs)

huc08_results_map <- huc08_conus %>%
  semi_join(allometry_results %>% distinct(huc), by = "huc")
```

```{r}
huc08_l1 <- read_csv(path_huc08_l1_lookup, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(huc = as.character(huc))

l1_col <- names(huc08_l1)[
  names(huc08_l1) %in% c("l1_name", "l1_ecoregion", "us_l1name", "na_l1name", "ecoregion")
][1]

huc08_l1 <- huc08_l1 %>%
  rename(l1_name = all_of(l1_col)) %>%
  select(huc, l1_name) %>%
  filter(!is.na(huc), !is.na(l1_name)) %>%
  distinct(huc, .keep_all = TRUE)

allometry_l1 <- allometry_results %>%
  inner_join(huc08_l1, by = "huc")

l1_order <- allometry_l1 %>%
  group_by(l1_name) %>%
  summarise(median_slope = median(slope, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(median_slope)) %>%
  pull(l1_name)

allometry_l1 <- allometry_l1 %>%
  mutate(l1_name = factor(l1_name, levels = l1_order))

allometry_l1 %>%
  count(l1_name, metabolism_metric, name = "n_huc_month_fits") %>%
  kable()
```

## 2. Assign HUC8s to Level I ecoregions

```{r}
allometry_l1 <- allometry_results %>%
  inner_join(huc08_l1, by = "huc")

l1_order <- allometry_l1 %>%
  group_by(l1_name) %>%
  summarise(median_slope = median(slope, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(median_slope)) %>%
  pull(l1_name)

allometry_l1 <- allometry_l1 %>%
  mutate(l1_name = factor(l1_name, levels = l1_order))
```

```{r}
allometry_l1 %>%
  count(l1_name, metabolism_metric, name = "n_huc_month_fits") %>%
  kable()
```

## 3. Annual HUC8 GPP and ER allometric slopes by Level I ecoregion

```{r}
annual_huc_slopes <- allometry_l1 %>%
  group_by(huc, l1_name, metabolism_metric) %>%
  summarise(
    annual_slope = median(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    annual_r2 = median(r2, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_months = n_distinct(month),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_months >= 6)
```

```{r, fig.width=10.5, fig.height=7}
p_annual_l1_boxplot <- ggplot(
  annual_huc_slopes,
  aes(x = annual_slope, y = l1_name, fill = metabolism_metric)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_boxplot(
    alpha = 0.9,
    outlier.alpha = 0.25,
    position = position_dodge2(width = 0.75, preserve = "single")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("ER" = "#440154", "GPP" = "#95D840"),
    name = "Flux"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Annual HUC8 GPP and ER allometric slopes by Level I ecoregion",
    x = "Median annual HUC8 allometric slope",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)
  )

p_annual_l1_boxplot

ggsave(
  file.path(dir_figs, "010_l1_ecoregion_annual_slope_boxplot.png"),
  p_annual_l1_boxplot,
  width = 10.5,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## 4. Monthly median HUC8 allometric slope by Level I ecoregion

```{r}
monthly_l1_heatmap <- allometry_l1 %>%
  group_by(l1_name, metabolism_metric, month, month_name) %>%
  summarise(
    median_slope = median(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_fits = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
p_monthly_l1_heatmap <- ggplot(
  monthly_l1_heatmap,
  aes(x = month_name, y = l1_name, fill = median_slope)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(median_slope, 2)), size = 2.7) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    name = "Median\nslope"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ metabolism_metric, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly median HUC8 allometric slope by Level I ecoregion",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray85", color = "gray40"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)
  )

p_monthly_l1_heatmap

ggsave(
  file.path(dir_figs, "010_l1_ecoregion_monthly_slope_heatmap.png"),
  p_monthly_l1_heatmap,
  width = 11,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## 5. HUC8 slope classes

```{r}
annual_slope_classes <- annual_huc_slopes %>%
  mutate(
    slope_class = case_when(
      annual_r2 < r2_threshold ~ "Low R2",
      annual_slope < slope_linear_low ~ "Sublinear",
      annual_slope <= slope_linear_high ~ "Near-linear",
      annual_slope > slope_linear_high ~ "Superlinear",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    slope_class = factor(
      slope_class,
      levels = c("Sublinear", "Near-linear", "Superlinear", "Low R2")
    )
  )

annual_slope_class_map <- huc08_conus %>%
  left_join(annual_slope_classes, by = "huc")
```

```{r}
annual_slope_classes %>%
  count(metabolism_metric, slope_class, name = "n_hucs") %>%
  group_by(metabolism_metric) %>%
  mutate(pct_hucs = n_hucs / sum(n_hucs) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  kable(digits = 1)
```

```{r, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
p_slope_class_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = annual_slope_class_map,
    aes(fill = slope_class),
    color = NA
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Sublinear" = "#2c7bb6",
      "Near-linear" = "#fdae61",
      "Superlinear" = "#d7191c",
      "Low R2" = "gray80"
    ),
    drop = FALSE,
    na.value = "gray95",
    name = "Slope class"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ metabolism_metric) +
  theme_map() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray85", color = "gray40"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

p_slope_class_map

ggsave(
  file.path(dir_figs, "010_huc08_slope_class_map.png"),
  p_slope_class_map,
  width = 11,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```
